field.label: Enable provider 1
field.help: Provider 1: Report on this provider. Providers 3 and 4 are off by default.

field.label: Provider 1 name
field.help: Provider 1: Display name, usually the ISP. Appears in every report and alert.

field.label: Provider 1 interface
field.help: Provider 1: OPNsense logical interface, not the device name, so reassigning hardware does not break accounting.

field.label: Provider 1 quota (decimal GB)
field.help: Provider 1: Monthly allowance in decimal GB, as the ISP states it.

field.label: Provider 1 billing-cycle day
field.help: Provider 1: Day of the month the allowance resets. Caps that reset mid-month are common.

field.label: Provider 1 warning threshold (%)
field.help: Provider 1: Percentage of the allowance at which a warning is raised.

field.label: Provider 1 cycle cost
field.help: Provider 1: What the cycle costs, used for cost-per-GB. Leave at zero to skip.

field.label: Provider 1 imported cycle baseline (GB)
field.help: Usage reported by the ISP before this plugin began accounting for the current cycle.

field.label: Provider 1 baseline cycle start (YYYY-MM-DD)
field.help: The baseline applies only to this cycle and expires automatically afterward.

field.label: Enable provider 2
field.help: Provider 2: Report on this provider. Providers 3 and 4 are off by default.

field.label: Provider 2 name
field.help: Provider 2: Display name, usually the ISP. Appears in every report and alert.

field.label: Provider 2 interface
field.help: Provider 2: OPNsense logical interface, not the device name, so reassigning hardware does not break accounting.

field.label: Provider 2 quota (decimal GB)
field.help: Provider 2: Monthly allowance in decimal GB, as the ISP states it.

field.label: Provider 2 billing-cycle day
field.help: Provider 2: Day of the month the allowance resets. Caps that reset mid-month are common.

field.label: Provider 2 warning threshold (%)
field.help: Provider 2: Percentage of the allowance at which a warning is raised.

field.label: Provider 2 cycle cost
field.help: Provider 2: What the cycle costs, used for cost-per-GB. Leave at zero to skip.

field.label: Provider 2 imported cycle baseline (GB)
field.help: Provider 2: Usage already consumed this cycle before the plugin could measure it. Added to the measured total, which closes the gap when vnStat has no history for part of the cycle.

field.label: Provider 2 baseline cycle start (YYYY-MM-DD)
field.help: Provider 2: The cycle start date the baseline applies to, as YYYY-MM-DD. The baseline is ignored for any other cycle.
